V. 38.
Here are two ſwords—Many of Galilee carried them when they travelled, to defend themſelves againſt Robbers and Aſſaſſins, who much infeſted their Roads. But did the Apoſtles need to ſeek ſuch Defence? And he ſaid, It is enough—I did not mean literally, That every one of you muſt have a Sword.
